heading: Security of nuclear facilities
lead: The Secretary shall conduct a research and development program on cost-effective technologies for increasing—

tree.text: the safety of nuclear facilities from natural phenomena; and
the security of nuclear facilities from deliberate attacks.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–248 struck out “, acting through the Director of the Office of Nuclear Energy, Science and Technology,” after “The Secretary” in introductory provisions.
